key_insight: The paper compares rule-based NLP and generative AI frameworks for converting disassembly manuals into structured, curated, machine-readable instructions.
engineering_relevance: Extracting reusable disassembly knowledge can provide a data foundation for future disassembly automation and circular manufacturing.
method: Implement a rule-based NLP extraction framework.
Implement a generative AI framework leveraging LLMs.
Compare both approaches using real-world disassembly manuals.
evidence_signal: Both frameworks were implemented and tested on real-world disassembly manuals, but the abstract reports no quantitative results or winning approach.
watch_item: Instruction accuracy and completeness require validation before extracted outputs can support automated disassembly.
paper_title: Automated Knowledge Acquisition Pipeline for Disassembly Instructions: A Comparison of NLP and Generative AI Frameworks
